# to run util/transcript.py

conda create --prefix /scratch3/yan073/conda/gridex2 python=3.10.19
conda activate /scratch3/yan073/conda/gridex2

conda install -c conda-forge ffmpeg

# 1. Install CUDA-compatible torch explicitly
pip install torch==2.4.1+cu121 torchvision==0.19.1+cu121 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121

# 2. Install whisperx WITHOUT pulling deps
pip install whisperx==3.3.1 --no-deps

# 3. Install remaining deps manually
pip install faster-whisper pyannote.audio

there is still error in the env. A possible better process is:

conda create -n whisperx_env python=3.10 -y
conda activate whisperx_env
pip install torch==2.4.1+cu121 torchvision==0.19.1+cu121 \
  --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
conda install -c conda-forge ffmpeg -y
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
pip install whisperx==3.3.1 --no-deps
pip install \
  faster-whisper==1.1.0 \
  pyannote.audio==3.3.2 \
  ctranslate2==4.4.0 \
  transformers \
  nltk
